# Agentic engineering

## Basic workflow

| Phase | Responsibility |
|:---|:---|
| **1. Explore** | Understand the codebase and conventions. |
| **2. Plan** | Define the steps and success criteria. |
| **3. Code** | Implement, test, and adjust. |
| **4. Commit** | Review, verify, and commit. |
